title: Massive Voting Data Analysis Pipeline - Anomaly Detection with LSTM and PySpark
description: Data analysis workflow for massive voting data using PySpark and MongoDB, with Docker-based infrastructure and recurrent neural network (LSTM/RNN) scripts for anomaly detection in electoral data. Developed as undergraduate thesis at UNAM. Companion repository of the Massive Blockchain Voting System (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.18780038).
